I wanted to say a couple things, so here's a little v/moshi news-post thing for ya. Feel free to discuss anything and everything in the comments.

Regarding the recent changes in moderation...

  • @Norge has acknowledged that he rarely uses voat anymore, so together we decided to remove him as a mod. He can still be contacted through the BaphoNet IRC, which he uses almost daily.

  • @lordoftheshadows has been busy figuring out life and stuff and hopes to be back soon. Because I find lord to be a person of admirable character and because there isn't really harm in keeping them around, they will remain a mod for now.

  • @Zaebos_11 was added to the team because he volunteered to do our autumn/Thanksgiving CSS. Because we could always use more CSS wizards to make this place pretty, I think he will remain on the mod team for now. Any problems/suggestions involving the CSS should be directed to him, and if you want flair, he can take care of that for you.

I would also like to mention that you don't have to be a mod to make this place great, as demonstrated by our wonderful community of moshlings who "cutepost" and make this place the cozy little bungalow that it is. <3 Keep being awesome!

Regarding NSFW Thursday...

Our resident host of NSFW night, @PM_ME_YOUR_ARCHES, is allowing v/soapdoxbanhammer to decide the theme of NSFW night. If you want to discuss NSFW night, check out their stickied post where you can submit ideas and stuff.

If you are weak of mind or heart, you may want to be careful what you click on that day! Regarding v/moshi Thanksgiving festivities...

To celebrate Thanksgiving by giving thanks, I plan on creating discussions so that we can discuss what we are thankful for. I think they'll have writing prompts and we'll focus on various aspects of our lives that we are thankful for. I'm thinking it'll be one prompt per day, for five days, with the last day being Thanksgiving.

I will use this opportunity to spice up the sidebar, because I think it could use something different. Probably for the last writing prompt, I'll ask something like, "What about v/moshi are you most thankful for?" and you can write about why you like it here and how it helps you and stuff. Then, we can put the best reasons why y'all like v/moshi in the sidebar, and they'll be like testimonials, sorta. You get the idea... and if you don't, I think it'll make sense later. Anyway, I know it's still pretty early, but think about what you might wanna write about!

So that was my idea for Thanksgiving. As always, if you wanna celebrate Thanksgiving here differently, or if you have comments or suggestions, let us know! If you have an idea but you aren't sure how many other moshlings would like it, you can create a poll and submit the link to your poll on v/moshi so that we can all vote on it.
